svg.title: 6. Open the extension
svg.desc: Start Illustrator again after completing the previous steps. Window → Extensions → Ashad Guide Layout Drag the panel tab beside your other panels to dock it. Open a document, set your margins, then use Preview / Create guides.

g.text: Start Illustrator again after completing the previous steps.
Drag the panel tab beside your other panels to dock it.
Open a document, set your margins, then use Preview / Create guides.
